# eon_restore_account_aws_s3_buckets (Data Source)

Retrieves the S3 buckets available to Eon in a restore account. Use this data source to select bucket names when configuring S3-related `eon_restore_job` settings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: List S3 buckets available to Eon in a restore account
data "eon_restore_account_aws_s3_buckets" "demo" {
  account_id = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
}

output "first_bucket_name" {
  description = "First listed S3 bucket name for the restore account"
  value       = try(data.eon_restore_account_aws_s3_buckets.demo.buckets[0].bucket_name, null)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the restore account.

### Read-Only

- `buckets` (Attributes List) List of S3 buckets available in the restore account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--buckets))

<a id="nestedatt--buckets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `buckets`

Read-Only:

- `bucket_name` (String) Name of the S3 bucket.
- `region_name` (String) Region where the bucket is located.
